POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.

comments: This license is almost identical to BSD-3-Clause, but adds "patent infringement" to the disclaimer.

evidence.locator: text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted" subject to conditions 1-3; broad non-reciprocal permission identifies a permissive family)
text: opening grant and conditions 1-3 (permission is non-reciprocal; no same-license, source-disclosure, corresponding-source, linking, or network-use condition is stated)
text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted"; no purpose, field-of-use, or commercial-use limitation is stated)

text: condition 1 (source redistributions must retain the above copyright notice, list of conditions, and following disclaimer) and condition 2 (binary redistributions must reproduce them in documentation and/or other materials)

text: conditions 1-2 (notice-retention/reproduction duties attach to source or binary redistribution; modification alone creates no separate condition, and no linking, network-use, or patent-claim trigger is stated)

text: condition 3 (neither the name of the HP nor contributor names may be used to endorse or promote derived products without specific prior written permission); final disclaimer paragraphs (express/implied warranty disclaimer and limitation of liability, including patent infringement among listed damages)

text: final liability disclaimer ("PATENT INFRINGEMENT" appears only in the excluded-damages list); complete license text contains no express patent grant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or defensive/retaliatory patent-termination clause, so patent position is none-stated
text: conditions 1-2 require retaining/reproducing the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer for source and binary redistributions (standard two-surface notice burden)
